plan.title: SRC-SUR-002 — Add surrogate bid on live reverse auction

steps.note: Open the prepared live reverse auction directly on its Participants tab, as required for prepared-state cases.
Ensure eRFX projects are enabled as required by the case configuration.
Have the buyer enter and save a 95 bid on behalf of Vendor A.
Assert that the surrogate bid was accepted and submitted.
Assert that the buyer's Responses view contains one response marked as a Surrogate Bid.
Open the comparison grid to verify the accepted surrogate bid participates in ranking.
Assert that Vendor A's QCS rate reflects the submitted surrogate bid.
Assert that the surrogate bid is ranked using the reverse-auction amount ordering.
